experiments.note: Without the freeze the April 2018 uprating would have applied: the November 2017 forecast's RPI for 2018, 3.304% (RPI!L21), on 57.95p. Later freezes keep the higher level and the 2022 5p cut is in cash, so modern law's 52.95p becomes 54.864p in 2024-25 and 2025-26. pe-uk's fuel_duty covers household car fuel only, so business and haulage fuel in the OBR's base are outside it.
sources: OBR Historical official forecasts database, Spring 2026, sheet RPI
